name: flowzone
description: Run secure FlowZone apps, including Markdown Review and Dyna executive dashboards for scheduled signals.

interface.shortDescription: Markdown review and scheduled executive dashboards.
interface.longDescription: Runs statically registered FlowZone apps through one local MCP server. Includes Markdown Review for line-anchored document feedback and Dyna for persistent, actionable executive dashboards built from scheduled Slack, Outlook, GitLab, and Codex signals.
defaultPrompt: Open a Markdown file for visual review.
Create an executive Dyna dashboard from my scheduled signals.
Open my Dyna dashboard and help me act on the highest-priority item.
Render this .md and let me comment on sections.
Review my Markdown and apply my feedback.
